title: Population Growth Holds Steady in Midsized Cities Amid Widespread Slowdown
content:
For Immediate Release: Thursday, May 14, 2026
Table 3. The 15 Fastest-Growing Cities and Towns With Populations of 20,000 or More: July 1, 2024-July 1, 2025
Rank | Area | State | Percent Increase | 2025 Total Population
6 | Haines City city | Florida | 10.0 | 45,973
Population as of July 1, 2024 Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 Population Estimates

source_claims.claim: Census reports 45,973 residents and 10.0 percent annual growth for Haines City in its Vintage 2025 comparison. This is population growth, not a count of immigrant arrivals.
The ranking compares incorporated places with at least 20,000 residents at the start of the July 2024 to July 2025 comparison period.
